title: Ismael
summary: Raleigh names Ismael in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ismael of the bloud of the Kings of Iuda, whom Baalis sent to slay Gedaliah. He is not Ismael the sonne of Abraham. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. VI, sig. 249b
